itinerary.summary: Walk the riverside between Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula and end at the evening aarti.

place.name: Laxman Jhula and Tapovan
place.description: The suspension-bridge stretch of Rishikesh, with the 13-storey Trimbakeshwar temple and a strip of cafés and yoga schools along the river.

morning.tip: The old Laxman Jhula bridge is closed to traffic; the new glass bridge alongside is the crossing.

place.name: Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
place.description: The abandoned Maharishi Mahesh Yogi ashram where the Beatles stayed in 1968, now a forest ruin of meditation domes covered in murals.

afternoon.tip: Foreigners pay a higher ticket; carry ID. Go at midday when the light falls through the domes.

place.name: Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan
place.description: The ashram's riverside aarti with chanting, drums and lamps circled over the Ganga at dusk, open to everyone.

evening.tip: Arrive by 5:30 to sit on the ghat steps; the best seats fill early.

itinerary.summary: Rafting in the morning, a slow afternoon in Tapovan.

place.name: Rafting from Shivpuri
place.description: The classic 16-km run from Shivpuri back to Rishikesh through rapids like Roller Coaster and Golf Course, with a cliff-jump stop.

morning.tip: Book an operator licensed by the state; rafting closes in the Jul-Aug monsoon.

place.name: Lunch and a sound-healing session
place.description: A long lunch at a cliff-top café, then a singing-bowl sound-healing session at one of Tapovan's studios.

afternoon.tip: Most sessions are drop-in; ask at the studio in the morning.

place.name: Triveni Ghat aarti
place.description: The town's biggest ghat, where locals float leaf-boat diyas on the river during a grand evening aarti.

evening.tip: Buy a diya boat from the stalls for a few rupees and float it yourself.

itinerary.summary: Morning yoga, then a forest walk to a waterfall.

place.name: Sunrise yoga by the Ganga
place.description: A drop-in hatha class on a riverside deck as the sun comes over the hills, the way to start a day in Rishikesh.

morning.tip: Drop-in classes cost ₹300-600; bring nothing but water.

place.name: Neer Garh Waterfall
place.description: A short climb through forest to a series of turquoise pools and falls, cool and quiet compared with the town.

afternoon.tip: The path is slippery after rain; wear shoes, not sandals.

place.name: Café afternoon and the Ram Jhula market
place.description: A last masala chai on a terrace and a wander through Ram Jhula's stalls for rudraksha beads, singing bowls and yoga wear.

evening.tip: Rishikesh is vegetarian and alcohol-free by law; meat and alcohol aren't sold in town.

stays.name: Aloha on the Ganges
stays.why: River-view rooms, a pool and yoga classes on site.

stays.name: Parmarth Niketan
stays.why: Simple ashram rooms with daily yoga and the aarti on your doorstep.

stays.name: Zostel Rishikesh
stays.why: Hillside hostel with a café and views, popular with solo travellers.

essentials.currency: Indian Rupee (INR). UPI and cards work in towns; carry cash for small temples, coracles and rural stalls.
essentials.language: Hindi and Garhwali; English common in Tapovan
essentials.weather: Oct-Nov and Feb-Apr are ideal (15-30°C). Rafting stops in Jul-Aug.
essentials.gettingAround: Shared autos run between Ram Jhula, Laxman Jhula and Tapovan; Dehradun airport is 35 km.

packing: Quick-dry outfit and spare clothes for rafting
Modest clothing for ashrams and ghats

summary.overview: Three days in the yoga capital on the Ganga: sunrise yoga, the Beatles Ashram, rafting through the Shivpuri rapids and the Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat and Parmarth Niketan.
highlights: Evening Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan
